subject: QBR prep: exec staff snapshot & tactical heatmap
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Exec Leadership <leadership@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: QBR prep: exec staff snapshot & tactical heatmap

Team — attaching a compact snapshot ahead of this afternoon's QBR dry run (attachment: 20280730-heatmap-slide-deck.pdf). High level below; please add line items to the tracker if you have edits (attachment: qbr-ready-action-tracker.csv / Drive link).

Wins:
- Hosted API latency improvements: p50 down 18% week-over-week for inference-critical routes after kernel swap.
- Two Dedicated contracts finalized (NimbusAI + Peregrine Labs); combined ARR +$1.2M.
- First-pass integration for private VPC onboarding automated for our top 5 enterprise customers — reduces provisioning time from 3 days to 8 hours.

Risks / Chokepoints:
- KV cache bug surfaced under sustained long-context sessions; mitigation plan in place but needs engineering priority. Estimated dev ETA: 5 business days.
- Capacity: east-us GPU pool is at 86% committed; possible QBR ask for short-term burst capacity.
- NimbusAI procurement flagged additional security evidence request (HSM integration specifics).

Asks / Decisions Needed:
1) Approve $120k one-time budget to temporarily provision burst nodes in east-us for 6 weeks (will avoid throttling high-value demos).
2) Confirm priority for KV cache fix; recommend we pause non-critical infra work for 3 days.
3) Laura, please confirm whether we escalate NimbusAI's HSM ask to Security and provide point people.

Quick schedule note: dry run 15:30 PT; please review slides and add comments inline.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
VP, Platform Operations
Redwood Inference

Added the numbers Laura requested into the tracker (qbr-ready-action-tracker.csv) and updated slide 3 with the burst cost / p99 impact modelling: 
- Without burst: p99 expected to rise by ~220ms across affected routes during peak; estimated 45 minutes of throttling for high-volume demos (probability 0.62).
- Burst cost (6 weeks): $118k total; cross-region canary estimate is $42k + 20% risk buffer for routing complexity.

Recommendation: approve the $118k burst for 6 weeks to preserve demo SLAs for top accounts; also authorize the cross-region canary plan as fallback (requires minor routing config change, ops ETA: 48 hours).

I've left a follow-up ask for Product to confirm whether any of the demos could be postponed or condensed; Marissa, can you coordinate?

Jonas Weber
VP, Infrastructure
